conclusion.name: 不朽晶鑽蛋
conclusion.unknownDescription: 尚未發現的一件未知藏品，有機率在「搶蛋大作戰」中探索獲得
conclusion.limitations: Locked screenshot does not distinguish normal/collector variants. No exact spawn location or final drop probability established.

itemDes.zh_TW: 堅硬無瑕的鑽石蛋，凝固著不再悸動的遠古生機。華光流轉不息，映照從亙古至永恆的漫漫時光。
itemDes.en: A flawless diamond egg, frozen with the heartbeat of ancient life long past. Its luminous glow flows without cease, a silent witness to the ages.

funcRep.zh_TW: 古文明遺留的珍貴藏品，價值連城，可以放入搶蛋大作戰的藏品展櫃中珍藏欣賞。獲得後可解鎖<style=Hint_BgL>S1賽季限定</style>的<style=Hint_BgL>伊莫飾品</style>。
funcRep.en: A precious collectible left by an ancient civilization. Priceless, it can be placed in the Operation: Egg Heist collectible cabinet for display and appreciation. Obtaining it unlocks an <style=Hint_BgL>S1-exclusive</style> <style=Hint_BgL>Aniimo Accessory</style>.
